# Security policy

[Português](SECURITY.md) · **English**

Thank you for helping keep joBot safe.

## Supported versions

joBot has no released version yet. Once there is one, only the latest version receives security fixes.

## How to report a vulnerability

Use only GitHub's private reporting:

**[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/fezarosa-dev/joBot/security/advisories/new)**

**Never open a public issue for a security flaw.** Anyone could see the problem before it is fixed.

## What to send

- What the flaw is.
- How to reproduce it, step by step.
- The impact (what a bad actor could do).
- The joBot version and your system (Linux, Windows or macOS).

## What to expect

- joBot is a personal project, maintained by one person. There is no guaranteed response time.
- I will confirm receipt and fix the problem when possible.
- If you want, your name goes in the credits of the fix.

## Scope

In scope:

- joBot;
- the local dashboard, which runs on your computer.

Out of scope: flaws in job sites and third-party services. Please report those to the owners of those sites and services.

## Important request

Do not test against other people's accounts or data. Use only your own data and your own computer.
